Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR CRYSTAL UNIT HOLDERS 

PART 3 TUBE TYPE CRYSTAL UNIT HOLDERS (GLASS) 
TYPES AP, AR, AS, AT AND AU 



u 



0. General —This standard shall be read in conjunction with \S : 4570 ( Part 1 )-1983 'Specification 
for crystal unit holders ; Part 1 General requirements and tests ( first revision )'. 

1. Type Designation — The tube type crystal unit holders covered in this standard shall be 
designated as under: 

a) Tube type crystal unit holder ( glass ) Type AP, 

b) Tube type crystal unit holder ( glass ) T/pe A^^, 

c) Tube type crystal unit holder ( glass ) Type AS, 

d) Tube type crystal unit holder ( glass ) Type AT, and 

e) Tube type crystal unit holder ( glass) Type AU. 

2. Outline and Dimensions — The outline and dimensions shall be according to Fig. 1 and Table 1.

3. Pin Spacing and Alignment Gauge — The pin spacing and alignment gauge for tube type 
crystal unit hoiders type AP, AR, AS, AT and AU shall be according to 4 of IS : 2684 ( Part 2 )-1972 
'Dimensions of electron tubes: Part 2 Miniature 7 — Pin type {first revision )'. 

4. Gauging Procedure 

4.1 The entire length of the pins shall, without undue force, pass into and disengage from the 
prescribed gauge.

Note 1 — For pin disposition, use the gauge as shown in 4 of IS : 2684 ( Part 2 )-1972. 

Note 2 — The bulb top line, from which dimension F Is measured, Is determined by a ring gauge with an 
internal diameter of 1M25 ± 0*025 mm. The edge of the gauge which comes into contact with the enclosures 
should have a radius of 1*127 mm.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The crystal unit holder outline covered in this standard correspond with Sheet 7 of lEC Pub 
122-3 ( 1977 ) 'Quartz crystal units for frequency control and selection, Part 3 Standard outline and pin 
Connection' issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission.
